subject.title: feat(dashboard): widget capabilities — net CSP, host tools, hardened shared sandbox

question: Should OpenClaw accept operator-granted dashboard widgets as a core security boundary with declared network access plus ticket-bound prompt, data-read, and cron-action Gateway capabilities?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow bug fix: it establishes a durable authority model across the sandbox, UI bridge, persisted grants, Gateway RPCs, and native protocol clients. That product and security boundary cannot be selected safely by automated review alone.

options.title: Accept the authority model
options.body: Approve the declared-grant, ticket-bound core capability design after owner review of its cross-client and upgrade contract.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the initial surface to read-only network and data capabilities, deferring prompt authorization or cron actions until their operator model is separately accepted.

options.title: Keep capabilities outside core
options.body: Pause this PR if the dashboard program should expose only rendering until a plugin or SDK ownership boundary is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept the authority model
recommendation.body: Approve the declared-grant, ticket-bound core capability design after owner review of its cross-client and upgrade contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed dashboard capability model and its cross-surface implementation are authored in this branch.
